FAQ

Junk removal questions, answered.

How much does junk removal cost in Los Angeles?

Pricing varies by amount and type of material, access, labor and disposal requirements. Request a quote for the specific job.

Do you offer same-day junk removal?

Availability depends on the business schedule and location. Contact the team about current pickup options.

What items can you remove?

Common services can include furniture, appliances, mattresses, household clutter, yard debris and other eligible materials. Restricted or hazardous items may not be accepted.

Do I need to move everything outside?

For full-service removal, the crew can typically handle lifting and loading from an accessible location, subject to service policy and site conditions.

Do you remove furniture and appliances?

Furniture and many household appliances are common junk-removal items. Ask about the specific item before scheduling.

Do you clean up after removing the junk?

Confirm the exact cleanup scope with the business when scheduling.

Do you serve apartments and condos?

Apartment and condo removal can be planned around access, stairs, elevators, building rules and parking conditions.

How do I get a junk removal quote?

Call or use the business's quote process. If photo quotes are supported, photos showing items and access can help communicate the job.
